rows.abstract: This bill seeks to enhance the privileges already granted to senior citizens by: (1) Including the costs of electric and water utilities in the list of items subject to the twenty percent (20%) discount privilege; (2) Exempting from the payment of real property taxes the family homes of senior citizens; and (3) Exempting from twenty percent (20%) withholding tax on interest income from bank deposits. > In addition, it is also proposed that funeral and burial expenses, including costs for internment, cremation and other disposition of a corpse, suitable monument, epitaph and cost of the burial lot shall be covered by the discount privilege as part of the social services afforded to senior citizen.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING STIFFER PENALTIES FOR INFIDELITY IN THE CUSTODY OF PRISONERS BY PUBLIC OFFICERS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: The penalties for infidelity in the custody of prisoners by public officers under the Revised Penal Code are light. Some criminals who were apprehended were able to escape from their detention due to carelessness of, or connivance with their custodians or public officers in charge. These situations raise doubts on the justice system of our coutnry and the loss of trust and confidence in the government. It is, therefore, the purpose of this bill to impose STIFFER PENALTIES on public officers forinfidelity in the custody of prisoners.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06419

rows.abstract: "Budget Office Act of 2002." This bill seeks to abolish the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) and create a new office under the Office of the President which shall be known as the `BUDGET OFFICE', which shall take over the powers and functions of the DBM. > The author of this proposed measure believes that budget administration, systems and processes need improvement. This bill endeavors to improve these functions through a simplified structure in budget management. rows.abstract: This bill prescribes that the Chief of Staff of the Armed forces of the Philippines shall have a fixed term of office of three (3) years, and the Major Service Commanders shall each have a fixed term of office of two (2) years. The terms shall commence on the date of appointment by the President. > No extension of term shall be allowed, except for the position of Chief of Staff, which may be extended in cases of war or national emergencies as declared by Congress. > When compulsory retirement age is reached before the end of term for any of the positions mentioned above, he shall be allowed to complete his term but shall be deemed compulsory retired upon completion of the same.

rows.abstract: "Rural Banks Act of 1991." Rationale: The rural banks play a major role in socio-economic development of the countryside, as more than eighty percent (80%) of rural banks' clients are within the poverty line. They keep the rural sectors at pace withcurrent economic trends and development, injecting dynamism to the rural areas through the motion of entrepreneurshi p, food production, livelihood projects, values formation, training and new forms of economic activities in the provinces. They mobilize small savings and provide rural workers access to credit in order to give them opportunity to improve the quality of their life. rows.abstract: "The Sangguniang kabataan Reform Law of 2002." This bill seeks to amend RA 7160 to strengthen and reform the Sangguniang Kabataan. rows.abstract: This bill aims to amend Sec. 70 of Ra 7160 by providing that; (1) Recall may be initiated by the registered voters of the local government unit to which local elective official subject to such recall belongs: (b) Recall of any elective provincial, city, municipal or barangay official SHALL be validly initiated upon petition of at least thirty percent (30%) of the total number of registered voters in the local government unit concerned during the election in which the local official sought to berecalled was elected; and (c) A petition of a recall of an elective Sangguniang Kabataan official shall be validly commenced by a petition of at least fifteen percent (15%) of the total number of voters registered in the roster of the Katipunan ng KKabataan during the election in which the Sangguniang Kabataan sought to be recalled was elected in the locality.

rows.author: C111
rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING THE AUTOMATIC APPROPRIATION FOR PUBLIC DEBT, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 292, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: The national government debt service is a continuing burdern to the Filipino people, which remains to have the biggest slice of the national budget. Our huge debt is not a sole obligation of the government, but in efffect, a burden shouldered by the people gravely affected by the shifting of budgetary priorities and expenditues for the much needed social services to the payment of interest and principal amortization for our enormous debt. > In the interest of the Filipino people, this proposed measure seeks to delete the provision on automatic appropriation for debt service provided under Section 26, Chapter 4, Book VI of EO 292 otherwise known as the Revised Administrative Code of 1987.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2002-10-23

rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE SALARY GRADE LEVEL OF THE SCHOOLS DISTRICT SUPERVISORS FROM SALARY GRADE NINETEEN TO SALARY GRADE TWENTY-FOUR
rows.abstract: It takes a great deal of teaching experience and administrative training before one get to be a School District Supervisor. It would therefore be only reasonable that this position be adequately compensated or at the very least be provided with a salary grade commensurate with the responsibilitie s connected with the said position.> This bill seeks to increase the salary grade level of all Schools District Supervisors from the present Salary Grade 19 to the proposed Salary Grade 24.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2002-10-23

rows.abstract: It is hereby declared under this Act that the Toll Regulatory Board shall be immediately abolished thereby repealing Section 2 of RA 1112. Upon abolition, the powers, functions and duties of the Toll Regulatory Board shall be transferred to and assumed by the Metro Manila Development Authority.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A COMPREHENSIVE JUVENILE JUSTICE SYSTEM AND DELINQUENCY PREVENTION PROGRAM, CREATING THE OFFICE OF JUVENILE JUSTICE AND DELINQUENCY PREVENTION UNDER THE DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: It is recognized that children in conflict with the law have varying special needs and thus their treastment at all stages, of legal proceedings should be humane, effective and fair. They should be handled differently from the way adult offenders are treated. Emphasis should be on the promotion of well-being and rehabilitation of children in conflict with the law rather than on punitive retribution. It is against this background taht the institutionaliz ation of the comprehensive Juvenile Justice System is urgent and necessary. Specifically, the proposed system shall create agencies as well as strengthen existing instrumentaliti es within the five pillars of the criminal justice system in order to protect children in conflict wiith the law. > This proposed bill adopts the framework of restorative justice which considers the welfare of the child offender as well as the interest and protection of the victim and the community. rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A CONGRESSIONAL MEDAL OF HONOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Instituting a Congressional Medal of Honor
rows.abstract: This bill creates a Congressional Medal of Honor to recognize members of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and the Philippine National Police (PNP) who exhibited uncommon valor and distinguished themselves above and beyond the call of duty.> The recipient of the Congressional Medal of Honor shall be entitled to promotion to the next higher rank, and shall include the grant of P100,000.00 to the awardee or to his next-of-kin.

rows.author: D067
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL PROGRAM FOR FILIPINO GIFTED CHILDREN AND SCIENCE-ORIENTE D YOUTH, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "Gifted Children and Science-Oriente d Youth Act." This bill shall have the following objectives: (1) Identify the gifted Filipino children and science-oriente d youth at the earliest age possible; (2) Establish a Center for the identification and nurturance of Filipino gifted children and science-oriente d youth; (3) Provide scholarship grants and other forms of assitance for identified Filipino gifted chidlren and science-oriente d youth; (4) Provide fund for research and development, curriculum development, training of parents, teachers and other personnel to carry out the objectives and programs of the identified Filipino gifted children and science-oriente d youth; (5) Provide incentives to government institutions and the private secttor that will participate in the implementation of this Act; and (6) Establish and maintain linkages with national and international institutions involved in programs on giftedness.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 2002-11-11
